methods.label: Recover the purchase cost and add the profit
methods.explanation:
The owner has already paid for all \(1500\) pencils. His total purchase cost is
\[
1500\times\$0.10=\$150.
\]
To recover that cost and make a profit of exactly \(\$100\), he needs sales totaling \(\$150+\$100=\$250\).

At \(\$0.25\) per pencil, the required number sold is
\[
\frac{250}{0.25}=1000.
\]
This is within the \(1500\) pencils available, and the sales exceed the total purchase cost by exactly \(\$100\). The answer is \(\boxed{1000}\) pencils, choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
